resources.string: Handles only the Nothing Essential Key (scan code 250)

Required for global hardware-key filtering. The service consumes only scan code 250 and runs the configured action. With separate ADB permission, screen-off presses are detected from a system-log stream filtered to this key. For Circle to Search only, it may reproduce a hold on the bottom navigation handle. It cannot retrieve screen content, type text, or collect accessibility data. A local diagnostic log stores only Essential Key processing stages and can be cleared in the app.
